Verified green: **103 checks pass** (11 more than my 92 — new tests came with it), syntax OK, 141/200 locals.

To be clear about authorship: this isn't my work. I pushed `9ceaf1a` and these changes appeared in the tree afterward. Reading the diff, it adds:

- **Per-dictation generation directories** (`CHUNK_DIR/g<N>`), with `getChunkFiles(dir)` now taking the directory explicitly
- **Job detaching** — a new keypress detaches the previous job instead of killing it, so it "delivers its own text" rather than having its audio deleted mid-transcription
- **`pipeInsertIsSafe`** plus `isWarmingUp` hoisted above the pipeline, so a finished transcript isn't typed into the middle of a new recording
- **Rescue on emergency stop** — `pipelineReset()` now returns an already-finished transcript to the clipboard instead of dropping it

It fixes a genuine bug in what I shipped: my version shared a single `CHUNK_DIR`, so re-pressing the trigger ran `rm -rf CHUNK_DIR` while the previous dictation's pipeline was still transcribing those exact chunks. I handled the *recorder* race but not the *pipeline* one.

I'm not going to commit it on my own initiative — it's a substantial rewrite I didn't author, and landing it would attribute it to me.
